title: Technician filter sits after Assigned to me in Tech View and Board View
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at location "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919" (on another site: the location named in the test run).
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide with the zoom at 100%, and the design picture "DC-18-tech-technician-chip-open-light-1440.png" attached to this case is open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and the rank numbers in the pictures are sample data. The picture's Department filter is left out of this release.
  • Technician "ZZAUTOTEST C590127 Yan" is active at this location and leads the Approved work order of customer "ZZAUTOTEST C590127 Technician Filter", unit "C590127-U1".
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Tech View" shown, no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off, "Search" empty, density "Regular".
  • If any record named above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look at the filter bar from left to right.
  2. Click the "Technician" filter.
  3. Look at the list that opens.
  4. Tick "ZZAUTOTEST C590127 Yan".
  5. Press Escape.
  6. Click "Board View" in the display switcher.
  7. Click "List" in the display switcher.
custom_expected:
Step 1: the "Technician" filter sits directly after "Assigned to me", with the design's thin outline wrench icon, the word "Technician" and a down arrow, as in the picture. There is no Department filter.

Step 2: a list opens directly below the filter.

Step 3: the list starts with "Unassigned", then the location's technicians by first name then last name, each with a tick box.

Step 4: "ZZAUTOTEST C590127 Yan" is ticked.

Step 5: the list closes.

Step 6: Board View shows the same "Technician" filter in the same place, still with "ZZAUTOTEST C590127 Yan" chosen.

Step 7: List's filter bar has no "Technician" filter.

Known problem SV-11326: staging has no Technician filter yet. If you see no Technician filter, mark this test Blocked and raise nothing new.
